commitMessage:
Forms: always-open titled sections instead of collapsible panels

- Every form section (Wajib, Tambahan, Atribut, …) is shown open as a
  bordered card with a bold title, like a classic admin form; section
  headers no longer collapse
- Sections that used to start collapsed (attributes, account) now start
  open so nothing becomes unreachable
- Speed unit selects on Account and Server show km/h when unset,
  matching what the app displays
